title: BackpackItem
description: A single Backpack entry. Use this schema to validate one item in isolation — for example a markdown file's YAML frontmatter, or a single record produced by ingestion. Two shapes are accepted: a raw natural-language string (matching legacy backpack.json practice) or a structured object that decorates the same content with explicit metadata. Per the freshness rules, every item MUST encode a YYYY-MM-DD date — either in the key it lives under or in the first line of the value/body.

oneOf.description: Raw natural-language entry. First line should contain a YYYY-MM-DD date. Update in place when the underlying truth changes; do not append history.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. Required when the item is stored as a standalone file (frontmatter), optional when keyed in a parent object.

value.description: The actual carry-state content. Plain text or markdown. First line should still encode the date.

summary.description: Optional one-line synopsis used by renderers (statusline, daily brief).

dated.description: The YYYY-MM-DD the entry refers to. Required if not encoded in the id/key.

created_at.description: When the item was created or last replaced in place. Mirrors _config:ttl[*].created_at in the legacy file.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds before the item should be re-verified or aged out. Common presets: 604800 (1w), 1209600 (2w), 2592000 (30d), 7776000 (90d).

review_after.description: Optional explicit review checkpoint, used when freshness is calendar-driven.

doctrine_ref.description: Optional id of a Doctrine entry this item implements or depends on.

hoard_refs.description: Optional ids of Hoard entries this item summarizes or was promoted from.

replaces.description: Id of a prior Backpack entry this one supersedes.
